newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks up as demand for banks continues.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks up as demand for banks continues.

text.p: BOGOTA, May 6 Reuter - Colombian stocks rose in sessions dominated for a second day by keen interest in banks, brokers said.
Bogota's IBB index ended up 0.85 percent to 1,162.86 on volume of 1.4 billion peso, while Medellin's IBOMED index closed up 0.79 percent at 17,635.14 on a
"I calculate about 80 percent of demand was driven by local investors with foreign funds showing particular interest in Banco Ganadero," one Bogota broker said.

One of the day's biggest gains was Banco de Bogota, flagship of the Luis Carlos Sarmiento financial conglomerate. Hot on a 13 percent gain Monday, the bank rose 2.56 percent to 6,800 in Bogota and 3.92 percent to 6,900 in Medellin. Brokers put the gains down to expectations of an imminent 42.8 billion peso rights issue.
Banco Ganadero ordinary shares were up 1.36 percent at 372 in Bogota and up 0.95 percent to 372.51 in Medellin.
"There's demand for these shares in New York, so that has a knock-on effect here," a Medellin broker said.
Banco de Colombia was also up 0.76 percent at 395 in Bogota, but dipped 0.51 percent at 390 in Medellin.
Insurance company Suramericana de Seguros was up 2.44 percent to 27,200 in Bogota and up 1.67 percent to 27,000 in Medellin.
"There's so few Suramericana shares on offer and sometimes brokers spend days trying to put together attractive packets," a Medellin broker said.
